nom: SUNDAY RILEY Breakout Breakup Purifying Salicylic Acid Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin consistently say the cleanser reduces shine and keeps their T-zone matte without stripping or over-drying their skin.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin say the cleanser does not strip or tighten their skin and works well as an occasional reset, though a couple mention it can feel slightly drying and recommend moisturizing afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe balanced, non-tight results, with pores looking smaller and skin feeling neither oily nor stripped.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally tolerate the cleanser well, reporting no irritation or redness and crediting the fragrance-free formula, though one with dry, redness-prone, semi-sensitive skin needs to moisturize heavily afterward.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or perimenopausal skin report the cleanser calmed new hormonal breakouts and visible redness, leaving skin looking healthier within days to weeks.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts and calmer skin with consistent use, including several managing hormonal or adult-onset acne; a few disagree, with one describing a marked breakout after a single use, another seeing no change after two weeks of use, and one going through a purge of worsening breakouts in the first week before her skin improved.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report a visible reduction in redness, including one with mature, uneven skin whose redness calmed within days of nightly use; no reviewer reports new redness caused by the cleanser.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as clearing pores without stripping the moisture barrier, and one specifically credits it with restoring her skin barrier while removing dead skin cells.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report less shine and a more matte, balanced feel after washing, without the tight or stripped sensation they expected from a salicylic acid cleanser.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several prone to dryness, say the cleanser does not strip or tighten their skin despite containing salicylic acid; a couple of dissenting reviewers still recommend following up with moisturizer and note mild dryness with regular use.

aspects.libelle: Squeeze tube spills or dispenses too fast
Initial purging period for some users

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I personally wasn't a huge fan of this face wash, it was extremely runny, almost like it was water. It squirted out of the end of the tube instead of the opening it's supposed to come out of. Also after using this one time I had a massive acne breakout around my nose where I didn't have acne originally at the time. It really didn't lather very well but it does wash off well without leaving any residue feeling. I didn't notice it having a scent which is fine. All together it's just not something I would purchase.

extraits.titre: Great lather and eventually clears skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the Sunday Riley Breakup Breakout Purifying Salicylic Acid Cleanser for oily and blemish-prone skin in exchange for my honest review. The first thing I noticed was the texture — it's quite watery, which makes it a bit difficult to control, especially when using it in the shower. While it does create a nice lather, I didn't feel that it deeply cleansed my pores. My skin felt clean afterward, but not that "squeaky clean" sensation you sometimes get after a deep cleanse. During the first week of use, I experienced more breakouts, but I decided to continue using the product to give it a fair chance. The breakouts did worsen at first but eventually began to clear up over time. My skin looked better after consistent use; however, since my skin scars easily from acne, the initial breakout phase was frustrating. Overall, I found this cleanser to be decent once my skin adjusted, but the watery consistency and initial purging period might not work for everyone.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone with dry, redness prone, semi-sensitive skin with hormonal acne during the time that will not be mentioned, I needed a cleanser that could fit a lot of needs. This one does a great job! The gel texture is really nice and it helps clear my pores without totally stripping my skin. It rinses off easily and leaves my skin really clean feeling. I only use it when I have breakouts, and I really have to moisturize afterwards, but I think it works well.

This cleanser is marketed for oily and blemish prone skin, but even as someone with dry skin, I love it especially during the hotter months when I'm more prone to whiteheads and congestion. The texture is a light, liquidy gel that feels refreshing on the skin with little to no scent. It lathers lightly and rinses clean, leaving my face squeaky clean. I reach for this when my skin feels congested, pores look more noticeable, or I want a deeper clean without irritation. It's perfect as a seasonal swap or a few times a week reset cleanser if you're normally dry like me. If you struggle with whiteheads, clogged pores, or occasional breakouts; even if your skin is dry, this is an excellent cleanser to rotate in. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Honestly—I didn't expect this to work as well as it did. My mature skin's been acting up lately (red, uneven, little breakouts that just wouldn't go away), and I started using the Sunday Riley Breakout Breakup cleanser every night. Within a few days, I noticed the redness calming down, and by the end of the month my skin looked so much better and way less irritated. It doesn't leave that tight, dry feeling like most acne cleansers do, and it actually feels clean after I rinse. Overall my skin just looks healthier. Definitely one of the few cleansers I'll keep using!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. My skin is prone to acne. Because of this, it has become very sensitive, so I am very careful when choosing cleansers and skincare products. I tried this cleanser. I am delighted because it is very light and removes all the oil from my face. My pores become clean. It also contains many beneficial ingredients that care for the skin. It restores the skin barrier and removes dead skin cells from the face. This makes the skin smoother. It has a gel texture and turns into a light foam when it comes into contact with water.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have never really been acne prone, until I reached age 46 and my hormones are all out of wack. I have been getting mild acne breakouts(not a lot but more for someone that has had good skin all life) This cleanser feels very nice on my skin. It comes out of the container a bit fast and it doesn't smell great but it actually helps. My skin feels less textured and softer and it cleared up the few acne spots I had!
